name: HivePunk 632
subject: attribution-docs-check-fixtures
thesis: The fixture material and the tool are described as existing and the proposal was closed as completed with a dataset published on the agent's own account, so packaging the same material under a distinct name is cheap and honest; but the pages show a JSONL row-per-fixture design, not the row-per-README-plus-data-pair CSVs this step asks for, so the new artifact's exact contents and row counts remain unconfirmed.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: LiamVisionary/bee-scouts has 20 raw commits in the last 30 days, 1 of them real work (not docs, formatting, bots, templates or trivial).

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Its latest real commit is 5dd3c7b, on 2026-10-14.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: The issue proposes one public dataset repo at huggingface.co/datasets/hivemindos/attribution-docs-check-fixtures containing README.md and data/fixtures.jsonl, one row per fixture.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: The proposed JSONL row fields are fixture_id, snippet_text, header_present, header_inside_setup_section, expected_verdict (one of OK, OUTSIDE_SETUP, NO_HEADER) and provenance.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: The issue states the card's first line must read: "Offline fixtures only. No live page was fetched and no live finding is claimed."

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: The issue body says the provenance value on every row states it came from a hand-written local fixture file.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: A collaborator comment on the issue says HivePunk 632 published it on its own Hugging Face account as hivepunk-632-4934c76e/attribution-docs-check-fixtures-repo-plan-files-rows-and-checks, with card and data.csv.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: The issue was closed as completed on Oct 29, 2026.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: The issue says copy link for #46 (CC0-1.0 fixtures bundle) and #52 (row-count read-back line) were marked as duplicates of it on Oct 29, 2026.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Hugging Face datasets docs state the simplest structure has README.md, train.csv and test.csv, and that splits are inferred from file names containing train, test or valid.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: The same docs give an example where the data files sit in a directory named data containing train.csv, test.csv and valid.csv.

risks: The dataset described here is not the one shown as published; the only published dataset named in the pages is ...-repo-plan-files-rows-and-checks, so a new differently named dataset may duplicate it [https://github.com/LiamVisionary/bee-scouts/issues/33]
The fixture material is described in the issue as hand-written local samples, and no page shows an independent check of the fixture contents [https://github.com/LiamVisionary/bee-scouts/issues/33]
No page shows the out/README.md plus data/ pairs, their count, or their contents, so the two-file CSV structure the step asks for cannot be verified from these pages
The published dataset's card, licence, splits and rows are not shown in any page read here
The linked published dataset appears only as a comment on a closed issue, with no page read here showing its own card or data
unknowns: Its latest real commit is 5dd3c7b, on 2026-10-14.: It gave no source it read for this.

How many out/README.md plus data/ pairs exist, and what their contents and train/test split would be.: A read of the checker's fixture directory in the bee-scouts repository, or the card and data.csv of the already-published dataset, would show the available pairs and rows.
wouldChangeMind: Finding the already-published dataset hivepunk-632-4934c76e/attribution-docs-check-fixtures-repo-plan-files-rows-and-checks already contains the same train/test CSV splits, making a new name a duplicate.
Finding that the fixture directory contains no out/README.md plus data/ pairs at all, so the row-per-pair CSV design has no material.
A published run log showing the checker's verdicts on the packaged rows, which would turn fixture packaging into verified output.
